# Benj Gershman

> Multi-platinum original bassist of O.A.R., keynote speaker, podcaster, and founder of Healthy Talks LLC. Based in Encinitas, California (North County San Diego). Delivers keynotes on mental resilience and team harmony for corporate HR, leadership, and student-leadership audiences.

Benj Gershman draws on over three decades on stage — including as the multi-platinum original bassist of O.A.R., a TEDxVailYouth speaker, and a DisruptHR San Diego speaker — to help organizations build resilience, work in harmony, and perform under pressure. He incorporates live DJing and layered music into every keynote, grounded in stoic philosophy and peer-reviewed research on anxiety, resilience, and workplace mental health.

## Signature Keynotes

- **Mental Resilience is the New Seatbelt** — Reframes mental resilience as a daily, learnable practice. Drawn from Benj's TEDxVailYouth talk. Available for corporate, higher-ed, and student-leadership audiences.
- **The Band Effect: How Great Teams Create Harmony** — A three-part framework (*Tune In, Turn Up, Rock It*) for building and sustaining high-performing teams under sustained pressure. Delivered at DisruptHR San Diego.
- **From the Stage to the Office** — A fireside-chat program co-presented with workplace mental-health expert Melissa Doman, M.A., for HR and leadership audiences.
- **Youth / Student Version** — The two keynotes blended for college-leadership conferences, student organizations, and high-school leadership programs.

## Workshops

- Seatbelts & Toolkits: Resilience & Burnout Prevention (45-min)
- Presence & Influence: Rock Stars Are Everywhere
- Intellectual Athletes: Mental Performance for High-Performing Teams
- Podcasting Workshop (45-min)

## Audiences

- Corporate HR and leadership teams — sales kickoffs (SKOs), all-hands, offsites, HR conferences
- Higher-education and student-leadership audiences — college conferences, student retreats, student organizations
- Mission-driven organizations in healthcare, wellness, and education

## Signature Close

"Be good to yourself. Be good to others."

## Formats

In-person (default) and virtual. Audience sizes 25 to 2,000+. Travels nationally from San Diego; international considered case by case.
